summary: Box 57307538 (RTX 3090 + EPYC 7502, ~115k steps/s training-only). NEW --energy-pot C (potential on z + |v|^2/2g, non-terminal): C=2 (ep2) raised the line's energy upstream but made dying at the deep dip pay (objective = progress + C x energy at death) -> 96.5% for 8 evals. C=1 (ep1, running): the greedy line's basement-entry energy rose 2,320 -> 2,440-2,560 (no earlier run moved it), arrival 1 s sooner, but fewer episodes reach the basement (1-5 of 9). Probe (analysis only): the incumbent's line is locally energy-optimal at every impact, so energy must come from route changes. Best eval so far 97.977 (incumbent 98.315). Next: chamber entries at the higher energy.
